Interactions & their partial dependencies

Code 
data <- 
  readRDS(here::here("Data/output/B_models/",
                     "B_01_list_all_results_rf.rds"))


fit_3 <- 
  data$res[[3]] %>% 
  extract_fit_parsnip()


train <- 
  data$list_split_data[[3]]$train

pdp_lnR_y_interactions <- 
  list()

Code 
pdp_lnR_y_interactions[[1]] <- 
  partial_dep(
    object = fit_3,
    X = train,
    v = c("Mass", "AOO"),

  plot() +
